name: My Life as a Teenage Robot
description: Jenny, aka XJ-9, is a super-powered robot with a super-sensitive teenage heart. Her primary function is protecting the planet from disaster, but – like all teenagers – she has her own ideas about how she would like to live her life. Bored with being a superhero, Jenny wants to do something really exciting – like go to high school!

videos.title: My Neighbor Was a Teenage Robot
videos.overview: The original pilot of the series.

videos.title: A Robot For All Seasons
videos.overview: Jenny volunteers to be a robot toy for an underprivileged tyke, Todd, at Christmas, only to become his unwitting, remote-controlled weapon in an attack on all the holidays. When Jenny becomes public enemy number one, she must prove that the little boy is the true villain before he forces her to attack Santa's workshop and destroy Christmas forever.

videos.title: Escape from Cluster Prime
videos.overview: When Jenny finds herself on Cluster Prime, the capital of Vexus' empire, she finally gets a chance to live with other robots like her. But there's more to Cluster Prime than meets the eye...

videos.title: It Came from Next Door
videos.overview: Brad and Tuck discover there's something very different about the girl next door. She is the super-powered Global Robotic Response Unit model #XJ9 but she likes her friends to call her "Jenny".

videos.title: Pest Control
videos.overview: Dr. Wakeman's mutant lab rats, led by the evil genius Vladimir, vow revenge on their creator by by trying to take control of Jenny's body.

videos.title: Raggedy Android
videos.overview: Jenny wants to go to the annual Townsquare Fair, but Wakeman is worried that someone in such a large crowd is bound to panic when they see a seven-foot mechanical teenager.

videos.title: Class Action
videos.overview: On her first day of high school, Jenny seeks to make some new friends with Brit and Tiff Crust. Unfortunately, the Crust cousins do not share the same feelings and plan to humiliate her.

videos.title: Attack of the 5½ Ft. Geek
videos.overview: Jenny makes a fan for life when she saves Sheldon from the shop class bullies. Jenny's happy to have another friend, but his instant devotion creeps her out.

videos.title: Doom with a View
videos.overview: A simple snowball battle between Jenny, Brad, and Tuck is interrupted by a strange robot ambassador who wants to make Jenny the newest member of the Cluster.

videos.title: Ear No Evil
videos.overview: Tiffany Crust has just gotten her left ear pierced for the third time and this makes pierced ears the hot topic of the day.

videos.title: Unlicensed Flying Object
videos.overview: Brad is disappointed by his lack of a driver's license, and Jenny's attempts to help him. Soon, he takes up joyriding in abandoned UFOs as a new hobby.

videos.title: Party Machine
videos.overview: Wakeman has to be out of town on the weekend of the annual Minutian invasion. She has just the weapon to repel them but she's doubtful her daughter can keep track of it in the disaster area she calls a bedroom.

videos.title: Speak No Evil
videos.overview: While on a mission in Japan, Jenny loses one of her language system discs, losing her ability to speak English. Stuck in Japanese, she encounters problems speaking to people back home.

videos.title: See No Evil
videos.overview: Wakeman gives Jenny new and (she thinks) improved eyes with the power to see an incredible spectrum of imagery that is invisible to the naked human eye. The only problem is they're huge.

videos.title: The Great Unwashed
videos.overview: Jenny has been invited to her handsome classmate Don Prima's latest party, but following the aftermath of one of her latest ventures, she needs to get a clean-up first.

videos.title: The Return of Raggedy Android
videos.overview: Brad has gotten an after school gig at the local malt shop. Jenny wants to hang out with him and the other teens but the owner doesn't allow robots. Jenny convinces Wakeman to revive her exo-skin concept to make her look like a normal teen.

videos.title: The Boy who Cried Robot
videos.overview: Tuck keeps interrupting Jenny's daily activity for every possible favor. When a big problem arises, however, Tuck's call for help winds up going ignored.

videos.title: Sibling Tsunami
videos.overview: One day, when Wakeman is out, Jenny discovers a secret room that stores her prototypes, XJ1 through 8. Excited to have sisters, Jenny activates them.

videos.title: I Was a Preschool Dropout
videos.overview: After discovering that Jenny is technically only 5 years old, the school system declares that Jenny has to be moved into an age-appropriate grade level, forcing her to adapt to kindergarten.

videos.title: Hostile Makeover
videos.overview: The Cluster infects Jenny with a microscopic nanobot that transforms Jenny into a Neanderthalish, robotic she-thing.

videos.title: Grid Iron Glory
videos.overview: While trying out for the cheerleading squad, Jenny catches the football coach's eye. She is quickly drafted to be the new quarterback.

videos.title: Dressed to Kill
videos.overview: Smytus, Supreme Commander of the Cluster Armed Forces, loses some rare and deadly power crystals on Earth.

videos.title: Shell Game
videos.overview: Sheldon continues to suffer through his unrequited crush on Jenny. She just doesn't look at him as boyfriend material.

videos.title: Daydream Believer
videos.overview: Jenny realizes she doesn't have dreams or nightmares like other normal people. She has Wakeman install a dream program that operates when she is in her sleep mode.

videos.title: This Time with Feeling
videos.overview: Jenny's desire to know the feeling of physical contact leads her to steal a set of artificial nerves from Dr. Wakeman. The nerves, however, have only two settings: tickle and pain.

videos.title: Saved by the Shell
videos.overview: The Silver Shell uses his influence with Jenny to set up a blind date between her and his unidentified 'pal'.

videos.title: Tradeshow Showdown
videos.overview: Jenny is bubbling over with excitement about attending her first Robotics Convention.

videos.title: The Wonderful World of Wizzly
videos.overview: On her first visit to the WizzleyWorld theme park, Jenny is appalled by the sweatshop -like conditions that the parks animatronics work in.

videos.title: Call Hating
videos.overview: Jenny hates it when her mom calls her on the pager/monitor inside her chest.

videos.title: Victim of Fashion
videos.overview: Jenny gets dissed by Brit and Tiff for "wearing" the same outfit everyday, so Jenny crams some fashion facts into her processors and the ultimate fashion competition begins. It's Jenny vs. the trend-setting Crust Cousins.

videos.title: Last Action Zero
videos.overview: Brad is frustrated with the secondary role he gets to play in Jenny's adventures.

videos.title: Mind Over Matter
videos.overview: The theory of planned obsolescence is introduced to Jenny when Brad buys a new calculator rather than upgrading his old one.

videos.title: Future Shock
videos.overview: Jenny uses one of Wakeman's inventions, the FutureScope, to see what will happen on Friday night.

videos.title: Humiliation 101
videos.overview: Tired of catastrophes and supervillain attacks, Jenny wishes she could have just one normal day as a teenager with no interruptions.

videos.title: Love 'Em or Leash 'Em
videos.overview: Trying to best his rival, Nora Wakeman, Phineas Mog builds a super robot hunk named Y-K9 (alias Kenny).

videos.title: Teen Team Time
videos.overview: When group of super-powered teens appears in town and ask her to join, Jenny believes she's finally found her niche.

videos.title: Robot for All Seasons
videos.overview: Jenny volunteers to be a robot toy for an underprivileged tot at Christmas time only to become his unwitting, remote-controlled weapon in an attack on all the holidays.

videos.title: Pajama Party Prankapalooza
videos.overview: Jenny gets invited to her first slumber party, a famous annual bash thrown by Brit and Tiff.

videos.title: Sister Sledgehammer
videos.overview: Jenny is captured by the Cluster and used as the centerpiece of a killer robot. The mindless automaton, under the control of Smytus, wreaks havoc on Tremorton.

videos.title: Dancing with My Shell
videos.overview: Wakeman won't let Jenny ask a boy to the Sadie Hawkins dance so she asks the Silver Shell (Sheldon's secret robotic alter ego).

videos.title: Around the World in Eighty Pieces
videos.overview: A mad mechanical wizard invents a Disassembler to split Jenny into her individual parts and disperses them across the globe.

videos.title: Armagedroid
videos.overview: Jenny is nearly destroyed by Armagedroid, the most technically advanced creature on the planet.

videos.title: Killgore
videos.overview: Killgore, a tiny, harmless, wind-up robot, is so determined to capture Jenny and join the Cluster that he nearly drives her insane.

videos.title: A Pain in My Sidekick
videos.overview: When Tuck discovers the Silver Shell outfit in Sheldon's garage, Sheldon buys his silence by making Tuck his superhero sidekick.

videos.title: Crash Pad Crash
videos.overview: Jenny, desperate for privacy, converts the backyard tool shed into an opulent crash pad.

videos.title: Designing Women
videos.overview: Sheldon nabs Jenny's blueprints to find a way into Jenny's heart, only to have Vexus steal them away from Sheldon.

videos.title: Robot Riot
videos.overview: Tuck is thrilled to be in a Robot Wars competition, pitting his robot against others in gladiatorial combat.

videos.title: Bradventure
videos.overview: Tired of being stuck under Jenny's shadow, Brad sets out to be his own hero.

videos.title: Mama Drama
videos.overview: Jenny is convinced that Dr. Wakeman's new boyfriend is a psychopath.

videos.title: Toying with Jenny
videos.overview: A mysterious toymaker offers to design an action figure in Jenny's image after she gets her picture in the paper for her heroics.

videos.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Troubles
videos.overview: Due to internal disputes, the Teen Team has broken up. With no place left to go, Misty heads back to Earth to be with Jenny.

videos.title: Escape From Cluster Prime [Part 1]
videos.overview:
Jenny is accidentally transported to Cluster Prime, the planet ruled by her nemesis Vexus and completely populated by robots, where she goes through an emotional roller-coaster ride.

(Part 1 of 2)

videos.title: Escape From Cluster Prime [Part 2]
videos.overview:
Jenny is accidentally transported to Cluster Prime, the planet ruled by her nemesis Vexus and completely populated by robots, where she goes through an emotional roller-coaster ride.

(Part 2 of 2)

videos.title: Weapons of Mass Distraction
videos.overview: Jenny tries to stop a new villain while hiding her superpowers from a handsome new boy at school.

videos.title: There's No Place Like Home School
videos.overview: Jenny is difficult in school, so Wakeman home schools her... and she's still difficult.

videos.title: No Harmony with Melody
videos.overview: Jenny is suspicious of Brad' new girlfriend, Melody, especially when disasters keep happening wherever Melody goes.

videos.title: Tuckered Out
videos.overview: Tuck does a school project about his hero, Jenny, and opts to make a movie about her, but his newfound power quickly goes to his head.

videos.title: Stage Fright
videos.overview: Jenny attacks ugly aliens who come to Earth to warn of an invasion by beautiful aliens.

videos.title: Never Say Uncle
videos.overview: Wakeman's earthy sister comes to visit, bringing her leaf-and-mud son, Glenn, but spends the whole trip arguing with her sister.

videos.title: A Spoonful of Mayhem
videos.overview: The embarrassed lieutenant of Skyway Patrol makes it his personal vendetta to take down XJ9.

videos.title: Enclosure of Doom
videos.overview: Jenny finds herself trapped in a mysterious enclosure with her nemesis, Killgore, and they must work together to get out.

videos.title: Teen Idol
videos.overview: A group of aliens see a flaming Jenny descending from the sky and decide that she is their Exalted One.

videos.title: Good Old Sheldon
videos.overview: A strange, old man claims to be Sheldon, saying that Jenny accidentally threw him into space with an alien race and he's been gone 75 years.

videos.title: Girl of Steal
videos.overview: Jenny steals a music player while in disguise as "Ruby Rocket," and an angry crowd forces Jenny to battle her alter-ego.

videos.title: Mist Opportunities
videos.overview: Jenny takes a break from superheroing when her friend Misty takes on that role in town.

videos.title: The Legion of Evil
videos.overview: Five of Jenny's B-villains band together to stop Jenny. Only by finding some teammates of her own can Jenny hope to defeat this dastardly group.

videos.title: The Price of Love
videos.overview: Sheldon tries to make Jenny jealous by paying Pteresa to be his girlfriend.

videos.title: Infectious Personality
videos.overview: Jenny becomes a carrier for alien microbes and her friends and family begin to morph into monsters. Jenny unknowingly brings back a virus from outer space that mutates the personalities, and then the bodies, of her friends and family.

videos.title: Trash Talk
videos.overview: Brad and Tuck tag along on Jenny's mission to a garbage dump asteroid.

videos.title: Agent 00' Sheldon
videos.overview: Sheldon is recruited by "The Agency" to become a secret agent and spy on Jenny.

videos.title: Indes-Tuck-Tible
videos.overview: When Tuck sees the future, he believes he is invulnerable.

videos.title: Puppet Bride
videos.overview: A robotic ventriloquist dummy that Wakeman once performed with returns to demand a bride.

videos.title: Historionics
videos.overview: Jenny and the boys crash land on an island where historical figures come alive.

videos.title: Ball and Chain
videos.overview: Looking for a serious beau for Tammy, Letta's biker comes to Earth for a shotgun wedding to Brad.

videos.title: Labor Day
videos.overview: When Jenny accidentally trashes Tremorton, the Skyway Patrol hands Wakeman the bill for the damages.

videos.title: Voyage to The Planet of The Bikers
videos.overview: Letta's Biker Gang rearranges Jenny, turning her into a motorcycle.

videos.title: Queen Bee
videos.overview: Brit and Tiff help Vexus disguise herself as a teenager at Tremorton High, but Vexus gets carried away in her new kingdom.

videos.title: Samurai Vac
videos.overview: Jenny humiliates a samurai by rescuing him and must help him regain his honor.

videos.title: Turncoats
videos.overview: Jenny's sisters turn against Wakeman.

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 4 wins & 12 nominations total
